summary: KALA BIO filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 5.08 and 8.01 announcing that its board set November 3, 2026 as the date of the next annual meeting of stockholders, a date advanced by more than 30 days from the prior year's anniversary. Because of the change, the company set a September 19, 2026 deadline for Rule 14a-8 stockholder proposals and by-law director nominations, to be received at its Arlington, Massachusetts offices. No special-situation event, transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisors were disclosed. This is an ordinary meeting-notice filing; watch for proxy details and any activist nomination activity before the deadline.
